scope: Few-shot with residual flows deleted, paired with EXP94 on the same remaining test rows. Reported in reports/20261106_exp95.tex.
design_note: The first run redrew training rows and refit PCA, so its differences mix three changes. The paired run keeps EXP94 training rows, replacing only residual ones, and separates PCA.

all_class_confusion_tabpfn_n50.note: Rows the nine-class TabPFN n=50 model predicts as inf or heartbleed, and bf false positives on the same test rows of the seven-class and nine-class models.

side_column_conflicts.note: Counts only, no model fitted. Key is netFound PCA 64 rounded to 3 decimals plus the side columns of the all_class run, on rows left after deletion. The port column counts only remaining flows, so 964 replaces the 1,143 of the earlier column in docs/lablog/evidence/20261105/exp94_flow_boundary_analysis.json, which also counted residual flows.

all_class_confusion_n50_mean.note: Mean count over seeds 43 to 47, rows are true classes and columns are predictions; CSV and netFound test rows differ.
